content.title: Vanderbilt vs. Nebraska: Predictions, How to Watch for Free (3/21)
content.text: No. 5 Vanderbilt (27–8) faces No. 4 Nebraska (27–6) tonight in the 2026 NCAA Tournament second round at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City in what is likely to be Saturday’s tightest matchup. Vanderbilt comes in off a surprisingly close 78–68 win over McNeese on Thursday. The Commodores rallied from an early 11-point deficit to close the first half up by three and never look back. Still, the game was never quite out of reach for the Cowboys, who remained in striking position until the final four minutes. Tyler Tanner led the Commodores with 26 points, seven rebounds, and five assists, while Duke Miles added 13 points and Tyler Nickel chipped in 12. Vanderbilt shot an efficient 51% from the field, while holding McNeese to just 36% shooting. Nebraska comes in off a dominant 76–47 win over Troy on Thursday. Pryce Sandfort paced the Cornhuskers with 23 points, including seven three-pointers, while Jamarques Lawrence and Braden Frager added 13 points each. Nebraska’s defense was the story, holding Troy under 30% shooting and forcing 17 turnovers in a commanding tournament debut. Prediction This matchup pits Vanderbilt’s high-powered offense against Nebraska’s disciplined defense and perimeter shooting. Expect long stretches of half-court execution and momentum swings, but Nebraska’s defensive consistency and recent confidence after its breakthrough tournament win give it a slight edge late. Predicted Final Score: Nebraska 74, Vanderbilt 71 Tip-off for today’s game between Vanderbilt and Nebraska is set for 8:45 PM Eastern / 7:45 PM Central at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The game airs on TNT and streams live on the TNT app and website, as well as HBO Max. If you’re a cord-cutter without an active livestreaming plan, you can watch the game for free by taking advantage of free trials from DIRECTV STREAM, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV. Hulu + Live TV also includes Disney+ and ESPN Select as part of its standard plan.
